description: This file contains a function 'transformProps' that processes chart properties and data to generate configuration options for an ECharts gauge chart, including styling, data formatting, and tooltip setup.

methods.name: getIntervalBoundsAndColors
methods.description: Calculates normalized interval bounds and corresponding colors for gauge segments based on input interval strings and color indices.

methods.name: calculateAxisLineWidth
methods.description: Determines the width of the gauge axis line based on data, font size, and overlap setting.

methods.name: calculateMin
methods.description: Calculates the minimum value for the gauge, doubling the smallest data value or zero.

methods.name: calculateMax
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value for the gauge, doubling the largest data value or zero.

methods.name: transformProps
methods.description: Main function that transforms chart properties and data into ECharts gauge configuration options, including styling, data formatting, and tooltip setup.
